answers.core: Because Y sorting has no ability to be finely controlled and is probably being used in a lot of 2D projects using top-down perspective
answers.workaround:
Any existing code which is already assuming things would sort only by their y position will work fine because y sort offset defaults to 0 which has no effect. This sort of code would only need to be updated if y_sort_offset was used in that project, and the changes needed should be minor.

If necessary, a helper function of CanvasItem which gets the "effective y position" when rendering by returning global_position.y + y_sort_offset could be added.
